subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: keeps staring at the camera while the closed-lip smile slowly stretches wider and wider toward the ears, then the lips part and the open mouth shows only a deep crimson bottomless void, no teeth, no tongue; holds it for a moment, then the mouth closes and the smile shrinks back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
